name: pulse-metric-studio
description: Pulse Metric Studio by ahillspace, a local desktop workbench for Tableau Pulse metrics.

scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @pulse-metric-studio/shared && npm run build -w @pulse-metric-studio/core && npm run build -w @pulse-metric-studio/pulse
scripts.test: node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.icons: node scripts/render-icons.mjs && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon.png --output src-tauri/icons
